en.headline: CHP infection control head issued warning over driving conviction
en.dek: The Medical Council ordered a warning letter for Dr Edmond Ma Siu-keung after he failed to report a 2024 dangerous-driving conviction within 28 days.
body: The Medical Council of Hong Kong has issued a warning letter to Dr Edmond Ma Siu-keung, head of the Infection Control Branch at the Centre for Health Protection, after finding him guilty of professional misconduct.

The disciplinary inquiry on Thursday heard that Ma was convicted of dangerous driving at Sha Tin Magistrates’ Courts on December 5, 2024. He had run a red light and turned right at the junction of Tate’s Cairn Highway and Siu Lek Yuen Road, colliding with a motorcycle and injuring its rider, who suffered back injuries. Ma pleaded guilty and was fined HK$3,000.

The panel noted that Ma had disclosed the pending case when renewing his medical licence in November 2024 and had pleaded guilty, but he did not submit a formal report to the Council within the required 28 days after conviction. The Council ruled that this breached the Code of Professional Conduct.
Ma attended the inquiry in person without legal representation. The warning letter is the penalty ordered by the Council.

zh.headline: 衛生防護中心感染控制主管因危駕定罪被醫委會發警告信
zh.dek: 馬紹強醫生因未在28日內向醫委會申報2024年危險駕駛定罪，周四紀律研訊後被下令發出警告信。
body: 香港醫務委員會周四進行紀律研訊後，下令向衛生防護中心感染控制科主管馬紹強醫生發出警告信，裁定他專業失當。
研訊得知，馬醫生於2024年12月5日在沙田裁判法院被裁定危險駕駛罪名成立。他在大老山公路與小瀝源路交界闆紅燈右轉，撞及一輛電單車，令車手背部受傷。他承認控罪，被罰款3,000港元。
小組指出，馬醫生在2024年11月續牌時已披露未審結案件，並在審訊中認罪，但定罪後未有在規定的28日內正式向醫委會申報。醫委會認為此舉違反《專業守則》。
馬醫生親自出席研訊，沒有律師代表。警告信是醫委會裁定的罰則。
